Why Release is unavailable

Release needs a current READY assessment, so every category must pass. These categories do not pass yet:

Crew: Unknown
Technical: Unknown
Statutory: Unknown
Emergency: Unknown

Emergency: no emergency preparedness source is connected yet, so this category stays Unknown. Current, human-verified muster and drill records (SOLAS III/19) with life-saving and fire-fighting appliance readiness would satisfy it once the emergency preparedness module (61.02) is delivered.

Statutory: no source defines the required-certificate set for this ship, so completeness stays Unknown even when every recorded certificate is valid and verified. A controlled required-certificate baseline for the ship would satisfy it.

Hold and Deny can always be recorded with a reason.
